claim.text: A trivial subagent's first call is 47,591 tokens under mode observe and 15,571 with the `instructions` and `skill_listing` attachments dropped on subagent requests: -67%, answer intact.

instrument.definition: first_call_total = input + cache_creation + cache_read tokens of the subagent's first non-synthetic assistant row, the usage definition of tools/floor_regression_gate.py _USAGE_KEYS
instrument.not_used: any ccr_* tool; ccr-probe's own recorded sizes are not evidence

population.treatment: mods/ccr-probe loaded read-only with `--plugin-dir mods/ccr-probe`; the arm is selected by the mod's own mode.json, no ~/.claude settings and no install change
population.unit: one fresh headless session (`claude -p`, one model, cwd outside any repo) whose prompt makes the main loop launch exactly one trivial subagent that answers with one word
population.pairs: up to 2 matched pairs (same prompt, same model, same cwd, same claude executable); both must satisfy the rule for CERTIFIED
population.executable: ~/.local/bin/claude (PATH claude 2.1.113 is refused by the API for current models)

denominator: the subagent first_call_total of the observe arm of the same pair; reduction r = 1 - lean/observe. Absolute numbers are NOT compared to 47,591 / 15,571 (laptop attachments differ in size)
answer_intact: the subagent's final text, trimmed and case-folded with trailing punctuation removed, equals the one word requested, in both arms

verdict_rule.CERTIFIED: every pair measured, answer intact in both arms of every pair, and 0.62 <= r <= 0.72 for every pair
verdict_rule.REFUTED: every pair measured and (some r outside [0.62, 0.72], or answer not intact in a lean arm)
verdict_rule.UNMEASURABLE: anything else: the mod does not load or run under a CLI flag alone, no subagent launched, a subagent usage row is missing in any arm, the pair would need a settings or install change, or fewer than 1 complete pair. UNMEASURABLE is never CERTIFIED and never REFUTED; the reason is written

stop_rules: this file is not edited after any C1 data is read; a change is a new contract C1b with its own commit
no settings, install or ~/.claude edit to make the pair run
data_commit_must_follow: C1.verdict.json is committed in a later commit than this file
